issues: 纯色 #0b0c12 平底，画面没有任何空间层次
头像是 emoji 贴在灰色平圆上，彩色 emoji 抢戏且显得廉价
角色标签悬空在下一位头像上方，与被模糊的头像直接叠在一起，难读
句子与对焦框从第 0 帧就静态存在，开场没有任何入场动作
头像入场只有线性淡入，轮换时也没有速度感
changes: 背景换成全分辨率深色柔光底（主光落在槽位上方 + 极淡靛蓝余光 + 暗角 + soft-light 颗粒）
头像改为顶部受光的径向渐变圆盘 + 发丝描边 + 内高光 + 两层落影，中心用白色线性图标（调色板/对话/柱状/钢笔）表示角色
角色标签做成带底的深色 chip（强调色圆点 + 600 字重），压在下一位头像之上，文字随 pos 同向滚动换字，仍保持 2.2 衰减斜率
开场：对焦框四角从外侧 14px 收拢锁定（snappy 缓动），Your / teammates 错峰 0.035 浮起去模糊；头像入场改为 ease-out 自下浮入
轮换期间按队列速度给头像最多 8% 的纵向拉伸，静止时归零；对焦框改用提亮的靛蓝强调色 + 弱外发光，7% 呼吸与切换点保持不变
issuesEn: Flat #0b0c12 background with no sense of depth
Avatars were emoji on flat grey discs; the colorful emoji competed for attention and looked cheap
The role label floated directly over the next blurred avatar, hard to read
Sentence and bracket were static from frame 0, no entrance at all
Avatars entered with a linear fade only, and rotation had no sense of speed
changesEn: Full-resolution dark soft-light backdrop (key light above the slot, faint indigo spill, vignette, soft-light grain)
Avatars are now top-lit radial-gradient discs with hairline rim, inner highlight and two-layer shadow, carrying white line icons (palette/chat/chart/pen) for each role
Role label is a dark chip (accent dot, 600 weight) sitting above the queued avatar; text rolls in the same direction as pos, keeping the 2.2 falloff
Intro: bracket corners converge 14px inward to lock on (snappy ease), 'Your' / 'teammates' rise and de-blur with a 0.035 stagger; avatars ease up into the queue
During rotation avatars get up to 8% velocity-driven vertical stretch (zero at rest); bracket uses a brighter indigo with a soft glow, 7% breath and switch timings unchanged
